title: Rich content native Windows acceptance catalog
scope: Interactive native Windows demo frontend with local fixtures. No real backend required. WebView2 allowed only for web content.
provenance_warning: Extracted bundle contains Codex and shared ChatGPT identifiers. Bundled code does not prove availability in the installed ChatGPT UI, enabled feature flags, or account entitlement.
status_policy: Keep native_status not_implemented until native behavior is built and acceptance tests verified. A gallery/mock/placeholder is not functional parity.

ipo.input: Draft text/document, attachments, reply context, keyboard/clipboard/drop events
ipo.processing: Maintain draft and selection; validate input; emit send/cancel/dictate commands
ipo.output: Editable draft and typed commands; preserve draft on failure

acceptance_tests: Type accented text and IME composition; Enter sends once and Shift+Enter inserts newline
Paste text and multiple files; failed send preserves text and attachment queue
features.limitations: Paste/drop/removal, dictation/send and reply UI inspected; messaging-specific limits must not be globalized.
features.demo_scope: Native interactive demo with fixture data; service actions simulated explicitly. Production engine parity is separate.
